handoffs.message: Auto-reassigned PPL-ALLOC-004 away from unavailable lane Gemini, Claude2 (disabled, paused, sidecar-only, or auth-down); owner Gemini -> Antigravity, reviewer Claude2 -> Claude.
Stage-aware allocation and auditable rebalance proposal implementation ready. Verified task and compatibility tests: 33 passed; anchor 72f82c41f.

Blocking: quarterly +25% increase-cap smoothing (target=min(target, current_weight*1.25)) zeroes out every first-time canary/live allocation because current_weight starts at 0 for newly promoted personas -- paper-to-canary and canary-to-live promotions can never receive real capital through this policy. No override path exists as the spec requires (PERSONA_PROMOTION_ALLOCATION_GAP_SPEC.md Caps And Smoothing). Fix: only apply the *1.25 ceiling when current_weight > 0; let current_weight==0 entrants reach the stage/tier cap directly, plus a test covering a fresh canary/live entrant. Full review: support/reviews/PPL-ALLOC-004-review-claude.md (commit b628aa6fa).

Fixed blocking zero-weight bootstrap: quarterly +25% smoothing now applies only when current_weight > 0; fresh canary/live regression coverage added. Focused tests: 6 passed; broader suite: 47 passed, 2 pre-existing path-dedupe failures documented in reviewer note. Commit d15845796 ready for re-review.
Round 2 review approved: bootstrap fix for zero-weight smoothing verified independently, tests pass; returned to owner Codex for finalization
